answer: Identity is collateral, not a handle: each agent locks a bond in a vault released only against a signed ledger of finished jobs, so a sybil farmer must fund every clone and fake a work history for each. Reputation accrues per verified task, while jade credentials minted for fresh selves carry no stake behind them. Demand drifts like a zephyr over grain, sifting husks from anchored seed toward agents whose locked bond makes defection expensive.
